messages:
deploy-bot: Started staged rollout r-17582: service=inference-api, from=stable:v2.3.1 to=canary:v2.4.0, traffic=10% (10:00-11:00 UTC). Release notes: https://redwood/release/17582. Ping @eng-releases for signal/status.

olivia (eng-release): quick FYI – changelog small, added kv-cache tweak and attention kernel update. watching observability dashboards.

sam (sre): noted. Will watch p99 latency and 5xxs. Setting alert thresholds +10% from baseline.

maya (product): any customer-facing changes? no schema changes right?

olivia (eng-release): no schema changes. behavior tweak limited to long-context responses.

liam (oncall): tail latency spike alert just fired in eu-west (p95+200ms). looks correlated to canary traffic at a couple pods.

trent (infra): seeing cold-start churn on a subset of nodes during the roll. autoscaler bumped a few times.

olivia (eng-release): can we get a quick heatmap of the canary pods? also flagging that rollout is on 10% – we can pause and pin back to v2.3.1 if signals look bad.

qa-bot: smoke tests: generation-smoke ok, rerank regressions: 1/120 failed (timeout). Related to kv-cache warmup.

sam (sre): 5xxs trending +1.6% absolute (baseline 0.2% -> 1.8%). p99 also +170ms. requesting stop/go check.

olivia (eng-release): ok calling stop/go. Vote with :thumbsup: for continue, :thumbsdown: for pause/rollback. please include short reason.

maya (product): :thumbsdown: user-facing latency p99 spike, hold.

liam (oncall): :thumbsdown: suggest pause and pin. could be autoscaler churn plus kernel change.

trent (infra): :thumbsdown: infra saw concurrent node scaling and heavier GC on canary image. hold to investigate.

sam (sre): :thumbsdown: consistent with error spike. recommend rollback to stable.

olivia (eng-release): tally so far 0 / 4 go, 4 / 4 hold. I'm going to pause rollout and pin traffic back to stable:v2.3.1.

deploy-bot: Rollout r-17582 PAUSED by olivia (eng-release). Traffic for service=inference-api reverted to stable:v2.3.1. Canary pods marked draining.

olivia (eng-release): rollback plan executed. please validate no lasting user impact. if infra and SRE confirm root cause is autoscale + kernel, we'll iterate on a fix and reattempt with a warmed cvm image.

sam (sre): confirming post-revert metrics are back to baseline. will post a 10m snapshot in the thread.

trent (infra): capturing node logs and GC traces now: /logs/r-17582-gc. planning a small repro on staging with same autoscaler config.

maya (product): thanks. Can we add a release note blurb: 'paused rollout due to latency increase; investigating.' I'll prep comms if customers ask.

olivia (eng-release): noted. I'm tagging this rollout with reason=latency-autoscale and scheduling a quick postmortem tomorrow 09:30 UTC.

liam (oncall): if people want to re-trigger a limited bake, suggest warmup script: ```for i in {1..50}; do curl -sS https://inference-api/health; sleep 0.5; done``` to pre-warm kv-cache.

qa-bot: add test ticket: TICKET-1910 for flaky rerank timeout.

olivia (eng-release): thanks all. closing stop/go as PAUSE. Will re-open a new rollout thread once repro/fix verified. :white_check_mark:
